name: bambu-studio
description: Local Codex integration for the custom Bambu Studio agent API, 3MF inspection, dovetail partitioning, reassembly plates, plate validation, and printer-prep workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Control the local Bambu Studio agent API for 3MF prep and validation
interface.longDescription: Adds a local MCP server, CLI wrappers, and workflow guidance so Codex can inspect Bambu Studio 3MF projects, run the custom agent API, create printer-oriented dovetail partitions, add reassembly plates, validate plate metadata without overclaiming UI behavior, and open outputs in the local custom Bambu Studio build for visual verification.
defaultPrompt: Partition this model for my H2D.
Add a reassembly plate for the generated pieces.
Validate plate layout before opening it.
